summary: Tractor Supply Company filed an 8-K on May 14, 2026, to announce a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.24 per share. This is a routine dividend declaration, not a special situation. The dividend is payable June 9, 2026, to holders of record May 27, 2026. No other event is reported. The filing is a standard current report for an ordinary dividend, with no merger, restructuring, or strategic activity. No special-situation analysis is applicable.
